home.heroSubtitle: Publish your cards, watches, vinyl records and figures, or bid on other collectors' items with clear and transparent rules.
home.step1Body: Set the starting price, the minimum increment and when your auction closes.
home.step2Body: Every bid must beat the highest one. Late bids extend the closing time.
home.step3Body: When it closes, the highest bid wins. Everything is kept in the history.
